title: Publish and list a public App
breadcrumb: Publish and list a public App
label: TIKTOK SHOP · DEVELOPER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-07-06
html:
Checklist

Once you are ready to launch your public app, complete the launch reviews in the same order used across the app launch documentation:

  1. Pass registration review.
  2. Complete and submit the language listing form for each target market.
  3. Initiate and complete app review.
  4. Pass compliance and legal review when required by your app scope, data access, market, or category.
  5. Complete beta testing only when required by the App review process.
  6. Publish and list your app on the TikTok Shop App and Service Store.

Use this order as the canonical public app launch path. If another launch guide describes the same steps, it should use the same names and sequence: registration review -> language listing review -> app review -> compliance and legal review -> conditional beta testing -> publish and list. For Connector definitions, beta testing trigger conditions, and seller authorization limit rules, do not rely on this guide as the source of truth. See App review process, where these operational rules are maintained.

Contact and support channels

For review questions, use the Partner Center support ticket path as the primary auditable channel. Use email for market-specific follow-up when your partner manager, review process, or support team asks you to do so.

Market or review area Primary ticket path Email channel Notes
United States How to contact support partner.us@tiktokshop.com Use for US launch, listing, or review follow-up.
United Kingdom How to contact support partner.uk@tiktokshop.com Use for UK launch, listing, or review follow-up.
Other markets How to contact support partner@tiktokshop.com Use for launch, listing, or review follow-up outside US and UK.
Compliance, legal, data security, or privacy review Data security and privacy review and How to contact support Use the market email above only when requested Start from the self-service checklist when the compliance step is visible. If it is missing or blocked, use the review document and support ticket path.

Pass registration review

Registration review confirms that your public app can proceed through the public app launch path. Complete this step from the app checklist in Partner Center before submitting language listings or app review materials. If the registration review step is not visible, confirm that:

  • Your app type is Public App.
  • Your developer onboarding status is complete for the target market.
  • The app category and target seller type are configured correctly.

If the step is still unavailable, open a Partner Center support ticket using How to contact support.

Set the listing language for your app

After registration review is complete, submit a language listing form for each target market. The language listing determines how your app appears to sellers in the TikTok Shop App and Service Store. Completing and submitting the language listing form initiates a review for that market. You must complete one language listing form for each market your app targets. Primary path: On the app and service detail page, go to Target Sellers, click the target market name, and then click Edit. Backup path: If you are already working from the publish panel, click Edit next to Publish. Use this only as a shortcut; the Target Sellers path is the more stable path because it starts from the market being edited.

Complete the listing form

For each market where you want to list your app:

  1. In Service overview, provide your app name, logo, short description, and at least one main image or video.
  2. In Detail introduction, provide three key benefits, additional images, a detailed app description, and supported integrations.
  3. In Contact & support, provide a valid support email address and optional phone number, website, FAQ, or user guide link.
  4. Click Next listing to submit this listing for review and move to the next listing, if applicable.

Note: After you submit the form, you cannot edit it during review. If the listing is rejected, edit the language listing form and resubmit it.

Listing field reference

The following field tables are the canonical reference for public app listing fields. Other pages, such as edit-your-app, should link to or mirror these field constraints instead of maintaining a separate, inconsistent field list.

App overview

Field name Type Field description Requirements Screenshot Seller side demo
App or service name Mandatory Provide an app name. A concise name helps attract more sellers and is the first thing sellers see in the App and Service Store. Text, less than 100 characters.
App or service logo Mandatory Upload a logo to help sellers recognize your app and brand. If your logo contains text, use the same language as the app listing. Maximum file size: 10 MB. Image ratio: 1:1. Minimum image size: 150 x 150. Supported formats: jpg, jpeg, png.
App or service language Mandatory Fill out the service information in the required target market language so local sellers can understand your service. Follow the language required for the target market.
App or service short description Mandatory Provide a short description introducing your service. Text, less than 200 characters.
Video or main image Mandatory Upload a video or image that highlights the impact of your app. Use at least one image or one video to describe your service. A video is recommended. Video: mp4, mov, flv; less than 200 MB. Image: maximum file size 10 MB; image ratio 5:3; supported formats jpg, jpeg, png.

Detail information

Field name Type Field description Requirements Screenshot Seller side demo
Key benefits Mandatory Provide three key highlights of your app. Each highlight must include a title and description. Use this space to address seller needs rather than explaining only how a feature works. All three sets are required. Text. Title: 50 characters or less. Description: 150 characters or less.
Image Mandatory Add additional images to demonstrate your app's value and attract sellers. Recommended content includes screenshots of featured functions, team images, or success stories. Supported formats: jpg, jpeg, png. Ratio: 5:3. Maximum file size: 10 MB. Provide at least one featured image; three to six images are recommended.
App or service detail description Mandatory Provide a detailed product introduction. Explain your service's key features and what sellers can do with your app. Text and URL links. 2,000 characters or less; 500 or less recommended. Do not use special characters or emojis. Do not include testimonials in the detailed description. Do not use personal information without written consent.
Integrations Mandatory List platforms or services that your app integrates with. This helps sellers quickly determine whether your app is compatible with the platforms they use. Examples: Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento, BigCommerce, Amazon.

Contact information and support

Field name Type Field description Screenshot Seller side demo
Phone Optional Leave a phone number for sellers to contact you. A local phone number is recommended.
Email address Mandatory Provide an email address so sellers can contact you.
Website Optional If you have an official website, enter a valid website URL.
App user guide or FAQ Optional Provide a URL for your user guide, FAQ, or other help resources.

Translate and import your listing content

After you finish creating your app listing for a specific market, you can use Translate and import from to translate and reuse listing content for other markets. Machine-translated content may contain errors or omissions. You are responsible for reviewing and verifying all translated listing content before submission.

Initiate and complete the app review form

Fill out the App Review form to initiate the app review process. Primary path: On the app and service detail page, scroll to the App Review section and click Submission materials for review. Backup path: If you are already using the publish panel, hover over Publish on the app and service detail page and click Modify. Use this as a shortcut only; the App Review section is the more direct and stable entry point because it shows the review status and submission materials in the same area. Complete the following steps to submit the form:

  1. In API Scope Information, confirm that the APIs integrated with your app are listed correctly. Modify the APIs if needed.
  2. In Product testing, provide the information needed for TikTok Shop to test and review your product, such as your product URL, test account, and testing instructions.
  3. In Product screenshots, explain your app's features, capabilities, and intended seller audience. Include screenshots and, optionally, videos.
  4. In Required Product Design, provide the design document you used to plan your app.
  5. Click Submit to initiate app review.

Note: After you submit the form, you cannot edit it during review. If your app is rejected, edit the app review form and resubmit it.

Connector, beta testing, and authorization-limit rules

Some app categories or launch paths require beta testing or additional review controls. This guide does not maintain the definition of Connector, the exact beta testing trigger conditions, or seller authorization limit rules. For the latest rules and required actions, see App review process. If beta testing is required for your app, complete it before publishing and listing the app.

Ensure you pass compliance and legal review

You must pass compliance and legal review for the relevant market before your public app can be listed on the TikTok Shop App and Service Store. Use this order of operations:

  1. Start from the compliance or legal review step in the app checklist when it is visible.
  2. If the checklist step is unavailable, review Data security and privacy review and follow the documented submission path.
  3. If you are unsure whether the review applies to your app, open a Partner Center support ticket through How to contact support.
  4. Use your market email contact only for follow-up when requested by your partner manager or review contact.

If you cannot find the compliance review step, first confirm that your app type is Public App. If it is public and the step is still missing, use the support ticket path above instead of relying only on email.

Publish and list your app

After you pass registration review, submit and pass all required language listing reviews, pass app review, complete compliance and legal review, and complete conditional beta testing if required, you have finished the steps needed to publish and list your public app. You can check the publishing status of your app on the app and service detail page.

  • If TikTok Shop approves your app, it will be made available on the App and Service Store for sellers to authorize. TikTok Shop will also provide an authorization link that you can copy and share with sellers individually.
  • If TikTok Shop rejects your app, click Edit to view the rejection reason, make adjustments, and resubmit.

Add new markets for your online public app

For an online public app, if you add new markets to your account, you can list the existing public app in the new markets by clicking Add market on the detail page. When adding markets, complete the corresponding language listings and submit them for separate market reviews. After the market review passes, the public app will be listed to the relevant target sellers on the TikTok Shop Seller Center App Store.
